title: Worker hello
description: The body of POST /api/station/stt/hello, as the GPU worker client sends it today (tools/stt_worker/worker.py hello; read by WorkerApi.handle, sizeup/cloud/sttworkers.py). JSON with a Content-Length, at most 1 MiB. The hub resolves the bearer token first: a GPU worker's own (sw1.<id>.<secret>), or a station's token for its whisper, which the hub knows as `station:<id>` and takes only while that station's whisper is in the pool. Sent once when the worker connects, and again after the hub was away.

worker.description: The id the worker believes it has. The hub does not read it: the id is the token's.

state.description: `online`, `gaming` (the machine is in use: no jobs) or `paused`. The hub ignores a word it does not know and keeps the state it had.

model.description: The speech-to-text model's name. The hub keeps 80 characters.

version.description: The worker client's version. The hub keeps 40 characters.

gpu.title: GPU
gpu.description: The graphics card as nvidia-smi gives it. The hub keeps only these keys, each a number or a string.

name.description: The card's name. The hub keeps it; today's worker client does not send it.

load.title: Load
load.description: A station's whisper only: its own work and pace. The hub keeps only these keys, each a number or a string.

own.description: Clips of the station's own being transcribed now.

rtf.description: Its measured pace: seconds of decoding per second of audio.

max_s.description: The longest clip it would take, seconds of audio. The hub never offers it a longer one.

why.description: With `paused`: why it is not claiming now.

models.title: Models
models.description: The models the worker serves. The hub reads it on every request (sizeup/cloud/infer.py seen); a key left out is unchanged. The worker client in tools/stt_worker sends it in every hello and state post.

llm.description: The language model; "" for none now.

self_update.title: Self-update
self_update.description: A GPU worker's self-update (tools/stt_worker/worker.py Updater): the worker.py it runs and what its updater is doing. Sending it is the capability: the hub answers `worker_update` only to a worker that sent it. A station's whisper never sends it.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the worker.py it runs, lower-case hex ("" when it can't read its file).

commit.description: The commit that file came from when the worker knows it (it updated itself to it), else "".

auto.description: auto_update in its config: false, it never updates itself.

state.description: The updater's state in words (current, staged, refused, rolled back, ...). The hub keeps 80 characters and shows it.

bad.description: Hashes it rolled back from and won't take again (the last 5).
